# Q42 starter

## Description

A dotspec starter with all nine Q42 dimensions and 191 distinct qualities from the pinned upstream revision. Dimension tags are represented as Sub-attribute of groupings, preserving all overlaps without implying exclusive decomposition, inherited obligations, or equivalent meanings. The 37 alias records are retained as alternative-name prose on their canonical qualities, not duplicate attributes. Names and groupings are adapted from arc42 Q42; explanatory questions are original dotspec authoring prompts. Upstream definitions, requirements, approaches, and standards are available through the source links.

## Edition

Upstream revision 0185215bfc133bac6a8091029b79b7104e47e351, reviewed 2026-11-10

[Q42 quality model](https://quality.arc42.org/articles/arc42-quality-model) by arc42 contributors.

**ID:** efficient
